prompt.en: What happened for the first time in Canada in 1951?
prompt.fr: Qu'est-ce qui s'est produit pour la première fois au Canada en 1951?

options.en: Most Canadians could afford enough food, housing and clothing.
options.fr: La plupart des Canadiens pouvaient se payer assez de nourriture, un logement et des vêtements.

options.en: Every Canadian home had a telephone.
options.fr: Chaque foyer canadien avait un téléphone.
Le Canada est entré aux Nations Unies.

options.en: Women were allowed to work outside the home.
options.fr: Les femmes ont été autorisées à travailler à l'extérieur du foyer.

explanation.en: By 1951 a majority of Canadians could pay for enough food, shelter and clothing, which had never been true before.
explanation.fr: En 1951, la majorité des Canadiens pouvaient payer assez de nourriture, un logement et des vêtements, ce qui n'était jamais arrivé auparavant.

source.quote: In 1951, for the first time, a majority of Canadians were able to afford adequate food, shelter and clothing.

verification.evidence: The discovery of oil in Alberta in 1947 began Canada’s modern energy industry. In 1951, for the first time, a majority of Canadians were able to afford adequate food, shelter and clothing.
